jica_manual_ref: Inspired by JICA SHEP PLUS — Watermelon production manual

varieties.name: Sugar Baby
varieties.supplier_notes: Round, 3-5kg fruit; dark green skin; popular fresh-market.

varieties.name: Crimson Sweet
varieties.supplier_notes: Oblong, 6-8kg; striped; sweeter, better shelf life.

timeline_template.description_en: Plough and prepare planting holes 2m x 1m apart. Add 1 tin manure per hole.
timeline_template.description_sw: Lima na chimba mashimo 2m x 1m. Weka samadi shimoni.

timeline_template.description_en: Direct-sow 3 seeds per hole, 2cm deep. Thin to strongest plant at 2 weeks.
timeline_template.description_sw: Panda mbegu 3 kwa shimo, kina 2cm. Chagua iliyo na nguvu zaidi baada ya wiki 2.

timeline_template.description_en: Apply 50kg DAP at planting (in the hole below the seed).
timeline_template.description_sw: Weka kilo 50 za DAP shimoni chini ya mbegu.

timeline_template.description_en: Hand-weed and mulch with dry grass.

timeline_template.description_sw: Weka kilo 50 za CAN kuzunguka mmea.

timeline_template.description_en: Spray for melon fly and aphids.
timeline_template.description_sw: Nyunyuza dawa ya melon fly na vidudu.

timeline_template.description_en: The canopy war: scout powdery mildew (warm-dry) and downy mildew (wet) — a burnt canopy at week 8 means small, bland fruit.
timeline_template.description_sw: Chunguza ukungu: joto-kavu (unga) na mvua (kijivu) — miti iliyochomeka wiki 8 inamaanisha matunda madogo.
CAN ya pili wakati wa matunda.

timeline_template.description_en: Remove deformed fruits; leave 2-3 best per vine.
timeline_template.description_sw: Ondoa matunda yaliyoharibika; acha 2-3 mzuri kwa mmea.

timeline_template.description_en: Harvest when the tendril near fruit dries + a dull thump on rind. Cut with shears.
timeline_template.description_sw: Vuna mkia karibu na tunda ukikauka + sauti nzito. Kata kwa mkasi.
timeline_template.tip_en: Don't drop watermelons — internal cracking kills shelf life.
timeline_template.tip_sw: Usidondoshe tikiti — hupasuka ndani na huharibika haraka.

timeline_template.description_en: The sugar test: harvest when the tendril opposite the fruit dries and the ground-spot turns creamy yellow.
timeline_template.description_sw: Jaribio la sukari: vuna wakati kikoleo kimekauka na doa la chini limegeuka manjano.
timeline_template.tip_en: Harvesting before the sugar is in is the #2 failure after mildew.
timeline_template.tip_sw: Kuvuna kabla ya sukari kuingia ni hitilafu ya pili baada ya ukungu.

post_harvest.grading_criteria: Grade A: 4kg+, uniform shape, no soft spots. Grade B: 2-4kg or minor blemishes.
post_harvest.packaging_standard: Loose on padded pickup beds (straw lining).
post_harvest.storage_tips_en: 10-15°C optimal. Refrigeration below 7°C causes flesh damage.

diseases.symptoms_en: Pin-prick stings on young fruit, larvae inside, rot from within.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa ya kuchomwa kwenye matunda machanga, viluwiluwi ndani, kuoza kutoka ndani.
diseases.treatment_en: Registered bait sprays; remove fallen fruit; harvest on time. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa za chambo zilizoidhinishwa; ondoa matunda yaliyoanguka; vuna kwa wakati. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.scanner_notes: Cut-open fruit photo shows the maggots.

diseases.symptoms_en: Colonies on new growth and undersides; they vector watermelon viruses.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Makundi kwenye majani machanga; wanaeneza virusi vya tikiti maji.
diseases.treatment_en: Squash early colonies; registered products if spreading. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Ponda makundi ya mwanzo; nyunyuza ikiwa yanaenea. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_sw: Chunguza kila wiki; maadui wa asili kwanza.

diseases.severity_classes: Low (dusting) · High (burnt canopy, small bland fruit)
diseases.symptoms_en: White dusting on leaves, canopy burn before fruit fill, warm-dry spells.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Unga mweupe majani, kuchomeka kwa miti, matunda madogo yasiyo tamu.
diseases.treatment_en: Sulphur-class or registered mildew products at first dusting. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa za salfa au zilizoidhinishwa mara inapoanza. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_sw: Hewa ya kutosha, epuka mkazo wa maji.
diseases.scanner_notes: Canopy-level photo; pre-fill timing is the decision point.

diseases.symptoms_en: Yellow patches above, grey-purple fuzz below, cool damp spells.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa ya manjano juu, ukungu wa kijivu chini, baridi na unyevu.
diseases.treatment_en: Registered downy-active sprays at first patches. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa zilizoidhinishwa za ukungu mara madoa yanapoanza. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.

diseases.symptoms_en: Sunken dark spots on fruit and leaves, wet weather.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa meusi yaliyozama kwenye matunda na majani, mvua nyingi.
diseases.treatment_en: Registered anthracnose-active sprays; no overhead watering. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa zilizoidhinishwa za anthracnose; usimwagilie kutoka juu. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.

diseases.symptoms_en: Brown cankers oozing gum on stems, wilting vines.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Vidonda vya kahawia vinavyotoa gundi kwenye mashina, miti hunyauka.
diseases.treatment_en: Registered sprays at first cankers; clean rotation. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa zilizoidhinishwa mara vidonda vinapoanza; zungusha safi. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.scanner_notes: Photograph the STEM canker — leaf photos miss it.

diseases.symptoms_en: One-sided vine wilt in heat, brown vascular streaks, death.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Kunyauka kwa upande mmoja jua, mistari ya kahawia ndani ya shina, kifo.
diseases.treatment_en: No cure — remove and destroy; grafted rootstocks where economic. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Hakuna tiba — ng'oa na uteketeze; miche ya kupandikiza pale inapowezekana. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.scanner_notes: Vascular streaking distinguishes from gummy stem blight.

market_notes.sell_windows_en: Prices peak in the hot dry months and festive weeks — a January harvest outsells a July one, sometimes 2:1. The sugar test: tendril dries + ground-spot turns creamy yellow.
market_notes.sell_windows_sw: Bei hupanda kiangazi na sikukuu — mavuno ya Januari yanazidi ya Julai, wakati mwingine mara 2. Jaribio la sukari: kikoleo hukauka + doa la chini linageuka manjano.
market_notes.price_notes_en: 25–60 KES per kg or 150–500 KES per fruit by size (November 2026). 2–3 weeks shelf life at most — sell into the demand windows.
market_notes.price_notes_sw: KES 25–60 kwa kilo au 150–500 kwa tunda (Novemba 2026). Maisha ya rafu wiki 2–3 tu — uza wakati wa mahitaji.
